_source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/decentraland/governance/master/src/intl/en.json (key modal.identity_setup.*). Copy/labels/steps are VERBATIM from the live decentraland/governance dapp i18n bundle. Flow structure derived from decentraland/governance src/components/Modal/IdentityConnectModal/* (AccountsConnectModal -> Discord/Forum/PushConnectionFlow -> FlowWithSteps Sign/Copy/Post -> PostConnection success/error, UnlinkAcountCard). NOTE: the modal/component .tsx paths under that ref 404 on raw.githubusercontent (only the i18n bundle resolves), so the component structure is reconstructed faithfully from the ui3 mirror GvAccountIdentityLinkingFlow.jsx + the i18n keys. Governance is NOT a Catalyst service (the DAO runs on Snapshot + Aragon externally) — there is no catalyrst governance route — so account linking, signature verification timers, and unlink are SIMULATED here; no remote calls.
title: Link your Decentraland profile to external services
description: By linking your Decentraland profile to your other social accounts you will be able to enhance your governance experience and never miss a beat of what's going on in the DAO.
timer: Time sensitive task. {time} left to complete
timer_expired: Signature expired. You'll have to start over.

forum.card_description: Publish comments on proposals using your Decentraland profile.
forum.title: Decentraland Forum Account

steps.title: 1. Sign message
steps.description: Use your web3 wallet to securely sign a message to start the linking process.
steps.card_helper_start: Your web3 wallet will trigger a signing request

steps.title: 2. Copy to clipboard
steps.description: You'll be using the same content as the signature for the next step.
steps.card_helper_success: Content copied. Click to copy again

steps.title: 3. Post on Forum thread
steps.description: Paste the content onto the comment box and publish to complete the linking.
steps.helper: Finally, comment on the signed message on the forum thread.

forum.success_text: Decentraland and Forum accounts linked successfully 🎉
forum.success_body: Now the comments you left on Proposals will link to your Decentraland profile. Happy governance!
forum.success_subtext: Plus, you'll get a fancy icon next to your username
forum.error_text: Governance and Forum accounts could not be linked
forum.error_body: Something happened. It must have been aliens or a malevolent AI but we can't be sure.
forum.error_subtext: Maybe just have a go at it one more time?

discord.card_description: Receive real-time notifications customized to your activity and never miss any important events.
discord.title: Discord Account
discord.subtitle: Follow these steps to link your account to your wallet and start getting notifications in Discord.

steps.title: 1. Sign message
steps.description: Use your web3 wallet to securely sign a message to start the linking process.
steps.card_helper_start: Your web3 wallet will trigger a signing request

steps.title: 2. Copy to clipboard
steps.description: You'll be using the same content as the signature for the next step.
steps.card_helper_success: Content copied. Click to copy again

steps.title: 3. Post on Discord channel
steps.description: Paste the content onto the designated channel to complete the linking.
steps.helper: Finally, send the signed message on the designated channel.

discord.success_text: Discord and Governance accounts linked successfully 🎉
discord.success_body: You'll start getting notified via Discord DM when there's new activity in proposals relevant to you.
discord.error_body: Something happened. It must have been aliens or a malevolent AI but we can't be sure.
discord.error_subtext: Maybe have a go at it one more time?

push.card_description: Receive notifications in your wallet or on any platform using this native web3 messaging protocol.
push.title: Push Protocol Notifications
push.subscribing_body: Confirm the signature request in your wallet to enable Governance notifications via Push Protocol.
push.success_subtext: Now you will receive Governance-related notifications in your Push account.
push.error_body: Something went wrong while subscribing. Please try again.
